title: Privacy Policy - FaisalTown Groups
description: Privacy policy for FaisalTownGroups.com, explaining how property inquiries and WhatsApp messages may be handled.
heading: Privacy Policy
subheading: How we handle inquiry details, contact information, and buyer communication submitted through FaisalTownGroups.com.
ctaQuery: I have a privacy policy question
body:
## Information We Collect

When you contact FaisalTown Groups through WhatsApp, we may receive your name, WhatsApp number, preferred plot size, budget, buying timeframe, message details, and other information you choose to share for property consultation.

## How We Use Information

We use inquiry information to respond to your request, share project details, arrange site visits, provide price-plan guidance, explain booking steps, and follow up on your property interest.

## WhatsApp Inquiries

Property inquiries from this website are directed to WhatsApp. WhatsApp links may open a pre-filled message containing this website address and the property question or requirement you selected.

## Sharing of Information

We may share your inquiry details with relevant sales or support persons only when needed to handle your request. We do not sell your personal details as a separate database.

## Cookies and Analytics

This website may use Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4, Google Ads conversion measurement and hosting logs to understand website visits, ad performance, and clicks on enquiry links when configured. These services may process browser identifiers, page views, ad click identifiers, and campaign parameters. WhatsApp enquiries may contain a short campaign reference so we can identify how an enquiry reached us. Clicking a WhatsApp link is not confirmation that a message was sent. Advertising and analytics cookies or tags may require additional consent mechanisms depending on applicable visitor laws; we will configure these before activating measurement for visitors where required.

## Data Accuracy

Property availability, prices, development status, routes, and payment procedures can change. We use your contact details to help verify current information before you make a decision.

## Your Choices

You may ask us to stop contacting you or update your inquiry details through WhatsApp.

For project information, return to the Faisal Town Islamabad homepage, review Faisal Town Phase 2, or message us through WhatsApp from the homepage.
